name: liquid-glass-cursor
title: Liquid Glass Cursor
description: Magnifying glass-lens cursor with chromatic-aberration SVG refraction over live wrapped content, hover shape morphing, and spring-smoothed tracking.

changelog.summary: Rebuilt as a magnifying glass-lens wrapper with chromatic-aberration SVG refraction over live wrapped content, replacing the previous GSAP hover-morph cursor API

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of the lens in pixels.

props.name: magnification
props.description: Zoom level applied to the content copy under the lens.

props.name: textHoverSize
props.description: Lens diameter when hovering a data-cursor="text" target.

props.name: maxButtonWidth
props.description: Lens width when hovering a data-cursor="button" target.

props.name: maxButtonHeight
props.description: Lens height when hovering a data-cursor="button" target.

props.name: distortion
props.description: SVG displacement strength for the glass refraction.

props.name: aberration
props.description: Chromatic aberration amount - how far the R/G/B channels split at the rim.
